'''Langu Sommilor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who was the [[Commissioner (Kynachi)|Commissioner]] of [[Kynachi]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], his [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was [[Mission to Kynachi|liberated]] from a ten-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] occupation by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Breakout Squad]].

==Biography==
Langu Sommilor was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kynachi (species)|Kynachi]] and the [[Commissioner (Kynachi)|Commissioner]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kynachi]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCWSM3" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' places events which take place before the ''Secret Missions'' series in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] group [[Breakout Squad]] [[Mission to Kynachi|liberated]] his [[Planet/Legends|world]] from the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]].<ref name="TCWSM1">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 1: Breakout Squad]]''</ref> Shortly after, he was replaced by a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Langu Sommilor (impostor)|imposter]], who [[Mission to Vaced|met]] Breakout Squad on [[Vaced/Legends|Vaced]]. The imposter was killed by a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]].<ref name="TCWSM3" /> Sommilor was soon found tied up in his [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], and went to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to meet with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="TCWSM4">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A Langu Sommilor first appeared in [[Ryder Windham]]'s young readers book, ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 3: Duel at Shattered Rock]]''. That Sommilor was revealed to be an impostor in the following book, ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]''.
